reviews.title: Please do no popup ads while I am searching for documents.
reviews.text: Please do no popup ads while I am searching for documents. Why is it that companies think they can force ads onto paying customers. I’m okay watching ads when using freeware, but not for apps I’ve paid for. Bad form.

reviews.title: Rubbish compared to FileBrowser App
reviews.text:
I've decided to delete this app after having it for about 8 years.  I discovered 'File Browser' app which is a ONE TIME purchase for £7.99 and does everything better than GoodReader.  

File Browser App have regular updates and also  doesn't  monitor any network connections or collect ANY of your data unlike GoodReader.  I wish I'd known about File Browser before.  

If you want to use one of the best iOS apps I've seen for iPad and iPhone, check out FileBrowser, read reviews and YouTube reviews you'll be amazed.  It also plays music, videos,  and able to read ePub books etc in one place - and connects to various remote drives including cloud based ones - amazing!  

I'm delighted to have discovered the FileBrowser App, and so will you. 

 Ditch GoodReader for their dodgy intrusion of privacy!

reviews.title: Latest update is awful
reviews.text:
I’ve been using GR for about a decade now. I’ve never had any problems, until this horrible update. 
Zooming-in by double-tapping is annoyingly inaccurate now. Some document outlines don’t expand anymore. Moving a document into a folder by dragging it now opens the folder after the move (didn’t ask for it), at the very least it should be a toggle-able option.
I know you want to improve your product but don’t try to fix what’s not broken and don’t reinvent the wheel when it rolls perfectly. What a bummer.

reviews.title: Sad
reviews.text:
I’m astonished that after 27 years, it’s still incapable of working with EPUB and LIT files. 

It doesn’t really like adobe protected PDFs either. 

It’s a nice teally colour.

reviews.title: samba fail
reviews.text: Synchronising with desktop Samba folders used to work well, but it has become a total nightmare. No matter what configurations or permissions I try, there are regular failures – a single file which displeases GoodReader will block the whole folder from updating. Delete and reset to the same setup as other folders which still work? Nope, same vague error message, over and over.

reviews.title: Latest update is awful
reviews.text:
I’ve used Goodreader for years, and the latest update makes it really frustrating. You keep on getting nags to upgrade to pro and messages that there are too many windows open. The way the workflow works for opening or adding files has changed because of the windowing, and what is my go to reading app is now really annoying. I’ll stick around for a while but if it doesn’t get better I will need to find an alternative. Previously, this would have been a 5 star app.

For reference, the workflow is opening files from dropbox or from an iPad download locally.

reviews.title: Annoying bugs
reviews.text:
There is an annoying display bug on iOS. When I switch to another application and then return to GoodReader, the app window suddenly shrinks and leaves empty space on the screen.
To get it back to full screen, I am forced to either completely force-close and restart the app or awkwardly tap the search button to trigger a layout refresh.
Please fix this UI layout bug in the next update!

reviews.title: Subscription after pay
reviews.text: Beware that after you pay for the app there are some features that are still behind a steep monthly subscription.

reviews.title: Not worth the money
reviews.text: Other options available with better features that do not look dated

reviews.title: User Policy go bad
reviews.text: Some function transfer to subscription needed. I brought this app years ago based on these features and seem just wasting my money.

reviews.title: Will not open I cloud folders just individual files
reviews.text: I would like to have this app open a folder that I have a very organized library of documents, but it only lets me import them one at a time and I refuse to do that. The interface for viewing a table of contents within a pdf is behind a pop up and not an all useful if wanting to use it to reference certain chapters within a PDF document.  This app may work well for some but is not conductive to my workflow.

reviews.title: Nonfunctional. It used to be a great app
reviews.text:
This was one of the first apps I got back in 2009 and has been fantastic until earlier this year. It doesn't work anymore, doesn't open, doesn't open files, it's nonfunctional...
Such a pity...

reviews.title: Scam to purchase subscription.
reviews.text: I originally purchase Goodreader years ago, would have considered to buy upgrade versions over the years.  However, APP developer got greedy and thinks this app warrants subscription with no real changes to its functionality.  A real shame, but had to move on to better alternatives.  Just wish I could use the older app that I paid hard earned money.  Good luck Developers of Goodreader as AI has replaced your talents.

reviews.title: Crashes constantly
reviews.text: iOS 26.2. Like the title said, it crashes constantly. It’s the only app I have that ever crashes. 2 stars because I like it when it runs. Updated Anan 2026: still the only app I have that crashed — and it crashes every single time I import a file/photo.
